verdict.rationale: Cekura has no documented export or data-portability feature. Its CLI manages agents, scenarios, runs and call data from the terminal, and a public OpenAPI spec plus SDK give programmatic access, so data could in principle be pulled out through the API. missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/audio bundles), export of recordings and evaluation results, account-deletion/offboarding guidance, independent confirmation that a full export works.
